deliverable: A source-grounded drift report, exact declared/observed CSVs, full differences, actionable plan and recoverable workspace for one approved public Git manifest.
execution: actual local foreground Node; no network or authenticated executor

stages.previousManualActivity: Select the manifest, extract declared hashes, read source blobs and build comparison CSVs.
stages.softwareReplacement: manifestSources and fixed Git reads automatically validate the approved scope and prepare exact inputs.

stages.previousManualActivity: Prepare a job brief and remember source, resource and permission boundaries.
stages.softwareReplacement: makePlan binds the commit, manifest, installed dependencies, ordinary Git modes, run ID, finite allowance and closed operations; checkedPlan verifies the exact approval digest.
stages.classification: plan preparation automated; authorization remains a user decision

stages.previousManualActivity: Invoke comparisons and collect their result records.
stages.softwareReplacement: The retained existing guide.compute catalogue specialist executes exact key/hash comparison.

stages.previousManualActivity: Check that every source and exception was included and that exports reflect the actual result.
stages.softwareReplacement: Independent exact-key/hash checks plus full approved-source and entire-output recomputation before first completion and reconnect. Separate Python CSV/Git/hash acceptance audits the package.
stages.classification: mechanical verification automated; independent organizational custody and customer acceptance remain unestablished

stages.previousManualActivity: Interpret differences and decide what should be changed.
stages.softwareReplacement: The supported offering automatically reports exact discrepancies and refuses to mutate or approve inspected source.
stages.classification: automatic report-or-refuse decision; choosing authoritative source or commissioning a repair remains a user decision outside this offering

stages.previousManualActivity: Prepare CSV downloads, evidence and a recoverable workspace by hand.
stages.softwareReplacement: Existing guide exports are packaged and source-reverified; complete artifacts are published only after full revalidation.
stages.classification: automated; existing delivered files are never overwritten

stages.previousManualActivity: Write a status handoff and copy source identities, results and cost caveats into it.
stages.softwareReplacement: The fixed report template writes a finished source-grounded Markdown deliverable with the exact historical reporting context and honest limits.
stages.classification: automated for this bounded integrity report; no claim of general article synthesis

stages.previousManualActivity: Remember where execution stopped, avoid duplicate output and reconstruct evidence.
stages.softwareReplacement: Immutable per-stage receipts, exact source/plan revalidation, full output recomputation, STOP and explicit stale-process recovery retain earlier bytes and unknown unfinished costs.
stages.classification: tested automatic bounded restart and duplicate reconnect; corrupted source/history refuses and may require a genuine exception decision

humanActivities.costTreatment: Unknown observed effort; amortize a declared setup investment across finite accepted volume.

humanActivities.costTreatment: Unknown observed effort; not fresh bespoke engineering on every job, and not zero.

humanActivities.activity: Maintain dependencies, source compatibility and regression checks
humanActivities.costTreatment: Model a declared period and utilization with finite volume; avoid charging the same investment twice.

humanActivities.activity: Perform routine input extraction, comparison, verification, packaging and report writing
humanActivities.costTreatment: Actual process and tool measurements are supplied; price compute/tools and expected failures explicitly.

humanActivities.classification: residual user decision or unsupported expansion
humanActivities.costTreatment: No automatic source repair or commercial acceptance is inferred from this offering.

humanActivities.activity: Handle genuine corrupted-state, infrastructure or unsupported-input exceptions
humanActivities.costTreatment: Exception rates and human exception time remain unknown; base/conservative/stress assumptions belong in the shared economic model.

routineOperatorMinutesInsideObservedAppr.reference: Observed bounded local processes ran all mechanical stages after the caller supplied the exact approval; this excludes scope decisions, engineering, deployment, customer acceptance and genuine future exceptions.

productionHumanExceptionRate.reference: Two task scopes and controlled recovery tests do not establish a production exception rate.

completeMonetaryCost.reference: Process measurements are supplied separately. Marginal, recurring and fully loaded costs require explicit prices, rates, utilization, finite amortization and residual exception assumptions.

candidatePromotion: No superiority or self-acceleration established. The existing catalogue specialist remains in service.
